description: Minimal bookmark management with a fast and clean UI. Simple installation through Docker and can run on your Raspberry Pi.

promotion.reason: Withheld pending real managed Windows authentication, exact private bookmark and tags, restart, keep-data reinstall, resource measurements and explicit hash-bound source review. Official MIT license, v1.47.0 release and maintained Debian Trixie image source were reviewed October 2, 2026.

data_storage: A Docker volume Local Store manages for linkding
risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in a Docker volume that Local Store manages for it. A keep-data uninstall leaves the volume; deleting data removes it permanently.
Not qualified on the Local Store managed engine. This withheld proposal is not installable from the catalog.

Choose an administrator username and password before installing. Both are required so this local instance cannot silently rely on missing proxy authentication. Local Store retains private setup answers for reinstall.
Bookmarks are private by default. Sharing a bookmark exposes it to other users of this app; keep private bookmarks unshared.

Linkding fetches bookmarked websites in background tasks to collect page metadata. The standard image does not include full browser snapshots; no AI service, cloud account or outbound webhook is configured.
The official standard 1.47.0 image uses Python 3.13 on Debian Trixie; this source review does not claim a vulnerability scan or guarantee that all image packages are patched.

resource_limits.reason: Bound the isolated Django and background-task instance to 512 MiB, two CPUs and 512 PIDs; record actual memory, CPU and volume measurements during a real task, restart and reinstall before promotion.
